title: Welder
description:
Welders
Baltimore, MD area

We are currently seeking experienced Pipe Welders in the Baltimore, MD area for a heavy industrial contractor. Candidates must be familiar with stainless steel and TIG welding for pressurized piping systems.

Responsibilities:
  • The ability to pass an ASME 6G 6 " Carbon Steel SMAW Pipe Test is a plus.
  • Work involves butt weld and socket weld of stainless-steel process piping (SCH 10, SCH 40, SCH 80 wall thickness). Socket Weld up to 2 " diameter. Butt-weld up to 8 " diameter. Welding will be performed in various positions, at various heights. Some welding work will be performed out of man lifts and/or scissor lifts.
  • Ability to set up the welding rig to your preferences, based on the environment and material being welded.
  • Work will take place in a variety of industrial manufacturing facilities.
Requirements:
  • Flexibility to travel between projects on a daily and/or weekly basis.
  • Driver's License and have reliable transportation to and from the jobsite within the DMV area.
  • Willing to work at least 40 hours per week (Mon – Thu on a (4) 10's schedule), with the flexibility to work overtime as required. Some night shift may be required, which is dependent on client needs.
Experience:
  • 2-5 Years previous construction experience, preferably as a Mechanical Contractor or Prime Contractor in an industrial environment.
  • Understanding of plans, specifications, P&IDs, and ISOs.
  • Self-Starter – Ability to work alone on a project, and as part of a team.
  • Effective verbal communication skills.
The pay range for this position is $25 - $32 per hour w/ PTO, medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, and 8 paid federal holidays.

If interested please apply to this ad or you can send your resume directly to Brittany at brittany@csrecruiting.com.

title: Installer/Carpenter
description:
Carpenter/Installer
Elkridge, MD

We are seeking experienced finish Carpenter/Installer for a growing specialty construction company who works within Baltimore, DC, and Northern VA area. They are a family-owned business who has been in business for 35+ years.

They install aesthetically pleasing acoustical wall panels, acoustical beams (cloth and leather), acoustic-wrapped ductwork, etc., within schools, business offices, factories, healthcare, churches, higher education, etc.

Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with Lead Carpenter/Installer to determine the best work sequences for each phase of the project to ensure successful completion to client's satisfaction.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Keep detailed notes of all work that is done and report progress to superiors.
  • Ensure materials are onsite.
  • Responsible for on-site end of day procedures, such as clean up, protection and security of all job materials and tools.
  • Maintain a safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following and enforcing (OSHA) standards and procedures complying with legal regulations.
  • Interact positively with other team members and trades to ensure site collaboration is good.
  • You will be responsible for ensuring customer and company satisfaction with your professional appearance, expertise in workmanship and good communication skills.
  • Must have basic hand and power tools.
  • Traveling throughout all parts of Maryland, Northern VA and Washington D.C.

Requirements:
  • 1-5 years' experience as a finish carpenter in the construction industry
  • Be able to read, interpret, and work from sketches, drawings, plans, and blueprints.
  • Safely operate tools and machines of the carpentry trade.
  • Safely lift and carry heavy tools and materials (minimum 50lbs).
  • Safely climb ladders and work at height.
  • The ability to read a tape measure accurately.
  • Understand plumb, square, and level (they must be second nature to you).
  • Must possess a valid driver's license with a clean driving record as well as reliable transportation is required.
  • All applicants will be subject to a Background check and drug testing.

This position is offering an hourly wage of $22.00 - $28.00 (based on experience) and includes helath, dental and vision insurance (50% - 70% employeer paid), PTO, 401(k) with a 4% company match, paid federal holidays, and more.

If interested please apply directly to this job posting or send your resume to Brittany at brittany@csrecruiting.com .

title: Pipefitter
description:
Pipefitters
Baltimore, MD 

We are currently seeking experienced Pipefitters in the Baltimore, MD area for a heavy industrial and mechanical contractor. Candidates must be familiar with carbon steel, stainless steel, fiberglass, PVC, HDPE, and copper pipes and be flexible with the work environment.

Pipefitter Responsibilities:
  • Experience running piping through active industrial production facilities is required.
  • Understand P&ID (Process and Instrument Diagrams) and can coordinate installation of valves and instruments as shown on the drawings.
  • Ability to field route piping where appropriate and required by the client.
  • Working with welded, threaded, Victaulic piping, carbon, and stainless steel.
  • Experience with the some or all of the following:
    • Carbon Steel – Threaded, butt weld, socket weld (1/2” thru 24”)
    • Stainless Steel – Threaded, butt weld, socket weld (1/2” thru 12”)
    • Fiberglass – Butt wrap & socket (4” thru 24”)
    • PVC – Socket & SDR-35 (1/2” thru 6”)
    • HDPE – Fusion Weld (4” thru 24”)
    • Copper – Threaded & Socket (sweat) (1/2” thru 3”)
Requirements:
  • Driver's License and have reliable transportation to and from the jobsite.
  • Willing to work at least 40 hours per week (Mon – Thu on a (4) 10's schedule), with the flexibility to work overtime as required. Some night shift may be required, which is dependent on client needs.
Experience:
  • 2-5 Years previous construction experience, preferably as a Mechanical Contractor or Prime Contractor in an industrial environment.
  • Understanding of plans, specifications, P&IDs, and ISOs.
The pay range for this position is $29 - $35 per hour w/ PTO, medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, and 8 paid federal holidays.

If interested please apply to this ad or you can send your resume directly to Brittany at brittany@csrecruiting.com.

title: Millwright Foreman
description:
Millwright/Mechanic
Baltimore, MD Area

We are working with a heavy industrial mechanical contractor that provides the installation, service, and maintenance of power and process systems in the manufacturing and power generation market. We are searching for individuals with experience in the industrial field with mechanical millwright capabilities that can install, maintain, and repair various types of industrial equipment.

Projects may include:

  • Structural Erection
  • Storage Tanks, Make Up Tanks, Process Tanks
  • Process Manufacturing Equipment Removal or Installation
  • Conveyor Systems

  • Ability to interpret plan view drawings for layout of equipment.

  • US Citizen and/or Green Card Verified

title: Service Manager
description:
Service Manager
Baltimore, MD

We are working with an established leading supplier of heavy equipment in the Mid Atlantic. They rent, sell, provide maintenance and repairs to a wide range of equipment for excavation, crushing, lifting, hauling and more. Equipment includes tack loaders, excavators, bull dozers, compactors, demolition equipment, etc.

Position Purpose:
The Service Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the service department to ensure the efficient, profitable, and high-quality repair and maintenance of customer and company-owned equipment. This role leads service personnel, manages work order flow, enforces safety and quality standards, and ensures customer satisfaction.

Essential Job Functions:
Operational Leadership
  • Manage and oversee all service department functions including shop and field service operations.
  • Supports a strong, team-based culture that aligns with investment in our people, taking care of our customers and achievement of core expectations.
  • Must be able to resolve both personal and customers issues promptly and effectively.
  • Successfully executes all action plans and strategies to achieve the desired outcome.
  • Possesses a strong business acumen to make sound decisions pertaining to the needs of the business including all aspects of the P&L and safety.
  • Schedule and prioritize work orders to meet customer needs and maximize shop and technician productivity.
  • Calling on existing customers to follow up on the recent service.
  • Monitor work-in-progress to ensure timely completion and accurate billing.
  • Manage warranty and policy claim submissions with OEMs.
  • Team Management
  • Hire, train, mentor, and evaluate service technicians and support staff.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching to improve productivity and quality.
  • Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Customer Service
  • Serve as the primary contact for major service customers, ensuring clear communication and resolution of service issues.
  • Work closely with customers to provide accurate estimates, timelines, and updates.
  • Address and resolve customer complaints in a professional and timely manner.
Financial & Administrative Oversight
  • Monitor department performance against financial and operational targets (labor efficiency, gross profit, WIP, recovery rate).
  • Approve work orders, invoices, and purchase orders in accordance with company policy.
  • Ensure proper documentation of service work, including time, parts, labor, and technician notes.
  • Open and Cost workorders in accordance with MLEC.
  • Safety & Compliance
  • Enforce company safety standards and ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental regulations.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Coordinate with Parts, Sales, and Rental departments to ensure smooth interdepartmental operations.
  • Participate in regular management meetings and contribute to strategic planning
  • Education and Or Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of experience in service management or supervisory role in heavy equipment, trucking, or a related field.
  • Strong technical knowledge of construction equipment and hydraulic, electrical, and diesel systems.
  • Proven leadership, customer service, and organizational skills.
  • Proficient with service software, Microsoft Office, and OEM diagnostic systems.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; technical degree preferred.
Physical Demands:
  • Standing, walking, talking, sitting, and use of hands.
  • This job mostly involves sitting or standing, but there may be occasional tasks that involve lifting or moving objects weighing up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment:
  • This position is exposed to work near moving mechanical parts, electrical systems, hazardous materials, fumes, airborne particles and moderate noise levels. Appropriate PPE gear must be worn as required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:
  • Must have valid Driver's License to operate company vehicles.
  • Must complete MSHA, First Aid, and CPR certifications as required.
  • Must complete in-service training as required including continuing education with verifiable credits from Manufacturer's technical schools or organizational training programs.

This position is offering a base salary from $100,000 to $125,000 with a competitive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, PTO, 8 paid holidays, and 1 personal day, HSA with a company match, 401(k) with a 3% company match, $30k life insurance and AD&D (employer paid), and short and long term disability (employer paid).

If you are interested in hearing more about this opportunity, please reach out to Brittany at brittany@csrecruiting.com for immediate consideration.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer
Winchester, VA

The Project Engineer will have the flexibility to assist with management of multiple projects in Winchester, VA, working up and down I-81, working directly with the Operations Manager. The Project Engineer will work to ensure that projects are delivered safely, on budget, within schedule and in compliance with the company's standards and to the customer's satisfaction.

COMPANY INFORMATION
We are working with a heavy industrial mechanical contractor that focuses on the installation, service, and maintenance of power and process systems in the manufacturing and power generation market. They are based in Baltimore, MD with a satellite office in Hagerstown, MD.

They have a focus on the process industrial market with their primary focus being the installation of equipment, piping, and structural steel for a core group of clients that demand quality, safety and reliability. With that in mind, they work in a wide range of environments from Food Grade Manufacturing to Chemical Processing and Power Plants.

Our projects may include:
• Storage Tanks, Make Up Tanks, Process Tanks
• Pumps
• Process and Utility Piping, Valves and Instrumentation
• Process Manufacturing Equipment Removal or Installation
• Structural Access Platform, Ladder and Stairway Fabrication & Erection
• Conveyor Systems
• Selective Demolition of items described above

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Daily coordination with the Operations Manager (OM) to support current and upcoming projects in the field.
• Assist with project buy-out for supplied materials, ensuring compliance with client specifications and industry standards.
• Expedite the material deliveries of subcontractors and suppliers in accordance with the project schedule and coordinate with the project team.
• Ensure project specifications are defined and adhered to. Seek clarification through the RFI process and ensure drawings are up-to-date.
• Manage specific budgets on a project-by-project basis within the company cost control system.
• Accumulate all necessary data for monthly owner and subcontractor applications for payment.
• Assist with pre-construction and progress meetings with clients and subcontractors, as appropriate.
• Assist with estimating new opportunities, to include labor production, material take offs and quotes, and subcontractor pricing.
• Maintain and complete a current record of submittals (when required), approvals and re- submittals.
• Other duties, as assigned.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT
• Establish a solid working relationship with each client that is assigned, that is founded on communication and understanding.
• Communicate the work plan, any issues, and progress to the client within the time frame that fits their needs (daily, weekly, etc.).
• Communicate daily (or more often as needed) with on-site supervision to discuss the plan, needs, and progress of each job task and project.
• Work with site supervision to develop and execute a construction plan for assigned
• projects, taking into account material and resource requirements, and working with the operations team to schedule those tasks accordingly.
• Visit the project sites to understand each client's business, facility layout, and project objectives.
• Communicate all plans, progress, and issues to the PM and OM as they occur.

ESTIMATING
• Accurately take off material quantities and solicit vendor quotes.
• Accurately identify subcontractor scopes and solicit vendor quotes.
• Estimate Client, material costs, subcontractor costs, and equipment costs for each estimate assigned.
• Craft proposal letters to clients, for specific estimates, including clarifications and exclusions.
• Review all estimates with the PM and/or OM.

ENGINEERING
• Understand the mechanical construction environment, hazards, and pitfalls.
• Understand the production capability for each assigned client.
• Understand the installation techniques for rotating equipment.
• Understand the installation techniques for piping, supports, and processes.

EXPECTATIONS
• Check in with assigned job site foremen daily (either over the phone, or in person).
• Check in with the Operations Manager daily (either over the phone or in person).
• Visit each job site weekly, at a minimum, or as required based on project needs.
• Photograph job progress (where allowed)
• Record subcontractor progress (where applicable)
• Submit salary timesheet to OM for review and approval, weekly.
• Submit mileage reimbursement and expense reimbursement (as applicable).
• Turn in delivery tickets, invoices, and any other paperwork to the Baltimore Office.

CORE COMPETENCIES
• Self-starter with the willingness to get involved in all aspects of a project, including troubleshooting and problem solving on-site.
• Accountability – Accepts personal responsibility for the quality and timeliness of his or her work.
• Communication – Communicates well both verbally and in writing.
• Teamwork – Builds good relationships and rapport with customers, peers, supervisors, managers, and field employees throughout the organization.
• Consistency – Consistently follows documented procedures and suggests changes/updates when appropriate.
• Scheduling and estimating experience are a plus.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills and organizational skills.

EXPERIENCE & REQUIREMENTS
• B.S. Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Process).
• 5-10 Years previous experience in millwrighting, preferably in an industrial environment.
• Familiarity with ASME codes & standards
• Familiarity with SMAW, GTAW and FCAW welding processes
• Flexibility to work in both clean (food-grade) and dirty (recycling facilities) environments.
• Reliable transportation with active driver's license
• US Citizen and/or Green Card Verified
• Flexibility to travel in the Baltimore Metro Area (Aberdeen, MD to Washington, DC)
• Willing to work at least 40 hours per week (Mon – Thu on a 4-10's schedule or Mon- Fri on a 5-8s schedule), with the flexibility to work overtime as required. Some night shift may be required, which is dependent on client needs.

This role is offering a base salary up from $75,000 - $100,000 (based on experience) and a competitive benefit package that includes 401k with company match, Per Diem for work that requires travel, Health / Vision / Dental / Life Insurance with company contribution, Short Term / Long Term Disability, Paid vacation and holidays.

If interested in learning more please apply directly to this job posting or send your resume to Brittany at brittany@csrecruiting.com .

title: Facilities Technician - Manufacturing
description:
Facilities Technician, Manufacturing
Bay Area, California

Role Overview

We are seeking a dependable and skilled Facilities Technician to support the daily operation and maintenance of critical infrastructure within our advanced manufacturing facility. This is a hands-on role responsible for routine maintenance, system troubleshooting, and ensuring 24/7 operational reliability across HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.

The ideal candidate brings a strong technical background and the ability to respond to complex equipment issues in a safe, professional, and timely manner.


Key Responsibilities

  • System Maintenance: Perform routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and repairs on industrial systems including boilers, pumps, air compressors, and exhaust systems.

  • Client Operation: Monitor and troubleshoot Building Management Systems (Client); respond to alarms, analyze performance trends, and escalate critical issues.

  • Utility Support: Assist in the operation of specialized facility utilities, including Deionized (DI) water, process gases, and compressed air systems.

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Support field-level repair of MEP systems across manufacturing, cleanroom, and corporate office environments.

  • Documentation: Maintain precise records of all maintenance activities and equipment startups/shutdowns using a CMMS platform.

  • Vendor Oversight: Escort and supervise external contractors to ensure all third-party work meets site safety and operational protocols.

  • Safety Compliance: Strictly adhere to Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), PPE requirements, and confined space entry protocols.

What You Bring

Education & Experience:

  • High School Diploma required; Technical trade school or Associate degree preferred.

  • 2-5 years of hands-on facilities maintenance experience, ideally in a controlled manufacturing environment.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency with diagnostic tools, meters, and technical schematics.

Technical Skills:

  • Working knowledge of industrial HVAC, chilled/hot water systems, and boiler operations.

  • Basic computer proficiency for system monitoring and data entry.

  • Ability to read and interpret complex equipment manuals and technical diagrams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Cleanroom environments (e.g., Specialty Chemical, Pharma, or High-Tech Manufacturing).

  • Proficiency with CMMS platforms (e.g., Maintenance Connection).

  • Active certifications: EPA Refrigerant Handling, Forklift Operation, or Confined Space Entry.

  • Familiarity with LEAN, TPM, or continuous improvement methodologies.

Core Strengths

  • Safety-First: A proactive commitment to following established safety procedures.

  • Accountability: Taking ownership of tasks and responding promptly to facility needs.

  • Collaborative: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external vendors.

  • Adaptability: Remaining resourceful and calm under pressure when handling unexpected equipment challenges.

title: Waterproofing Foreman/Superintendent
description:
We are actively searching for a Waterproofing Foreman/Superintendent in the DC Metro area for an ultra-high end custom estate contractor. This client isn't just known for building houses, but curating legacies. They pride themselves on unparalleled craftsmanship and sophisticated project management. Now looking for an Assistant Controller who is as precise with numbers as their artisans are with their craft.

Position Summary

The Waterproofing Team Foreman is a critical, hands-on role. You will own the execution of

our comprehensive weatherization and water management strategies. You will manage a

dedicated crew and work hands-on to seal the entire building envelope, including below-grade

foundations, slab assemblies, exterior walls, window/door transitions, and flat roofs. Your

single, uncompromising objective is to keep all unwanted water out of our Clients' luxury

residences.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Envelope Execution & Application

• Below-Grade & Foundations: Oversee and execute multi-layer foundation

waterproofing, including fluid-applied membranes, dimple boards, and complex footer

drainage systems.

• Slabs & Horizontal Barriers: Install high-performance under slab vapor barriers, capillary

breaks, and cold-joint water stops to eliminate moisture transmission.

• Above-Grade Walls: Apply advanced weather-resistive barriers (WRBs), self-adhered

flashings, and liquid-applied air/vapor barriers to complex framing layouts.

• Penetrations & Openings: Detail critical window, door, and mechanical penetrations

with meticulous pan flashings, sill tapes, and custom sealant joints.

• Flat Roofs & Decks: Supervise the installation and detailing of low-slope roof

membranes (modified bitumen, TPO, or cold-fluid applied) and plaza deck assemblies.

Crew Leadership & Quality Control

• Lead by example as a working foreman, driving field production while maintaining a

clean, highly organized, and respectful job site.

• Enforce strict compliance with manufacturer specifications for elite systems, specifically

including Tremco, Polyglass, or approved equivalent high-end product lines.

• Verify rigorous application metrics, including wet/dry mil thickness testing, substrate

moisture levels, ambient temperature restrictions, and proper curing windows.

• Identify and have corrected any framing, masonry, or concrete defects before

waterproofing materials are applied.

Site Operations & Communication

• Interpret complex architectural blueprints, structural drawings, and building envelope

details flawlessly.

• Maintain daily digital field logs using project software, capturing detailed photos of

buried components (e.g., foundation membranes before backfill).

• Coordinate seamless handoffs with framing, window installation, roofing, and MEP

Trades and Landscaping Subcontractors.

1Job Qualifications & Requirements

Experience & Material Mastery

• Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in residential waterproofing or high-

performance home building envelopes.

• Proven track record in a leadership or foreman capacity on custom residential or highly

detailed light commercial builds.

• Deep product fluency with commercial-grade residential lines, including Tremco (Exoair

commercial systems), Polyglass (self-adhered membranes), Prosoco, or Carlisle. Must be

a manufacturer-certified installer of Tremco®, Polyglass®, or equivalent.

• Comprehensive knowledge of building science principles, drainage planes, rainscreen

systems, and vapor transmission.

Physical & Logistical Requirements

• Ability to work comfortably at heights (scaffolding, ladders, flat roofs) and in tight

conditions (excavated foundations, crawl spaces).

• Digital literacy to navigate field management apps, track crew hours, and document

field conditions.

• Valid driver's license with a clean record to operate company vehicle across the DMV

area.

• Fluent or functional bilingual proficiency (English/Spanish) is highly desirable.

Benefits & Compensation

• Premium hourly rate or salary package reflective of high-end residential trade mastery.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

• Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.

• Company-provided vehicle or tool/truck allowance, plus fuel card.

• Retirement plan.

• Salary range commensurate with experience.

For more information or immediate consideration, please contact Mike Murphy at mike@csrecruiting.com or apply directly to this posting.
